package processor

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Sidiora-Technologies/KindleLaunch/core/indexer/internal/decode"
	"github.com/Sidiora-Technologies/KindleLaunch/core/indexer/internal/internaltest"
	"github.com/Sidiora-Technologies/KindleLaunch/core/indexer/internal/store"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/common"
	"github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/core/types"
)

func TestRepair_61_real_consumer(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("REPAIR61_LOGS"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var observations []struct {
		Role     string
		Log      types.Log
		Old, New uint8
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &observations); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(observations) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("received %d producer observations", len(observations))
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	_, pool := internaltest.NewPostgres(t)
	decoder := decode.NewDecoder()
	processor := New(Deps{Store: store.New(pool), Decoder: decoder, ChainID: 125})
	for _, observation := range observations {
		log := observation.Log
		event, err := decoder.Decode(log)
		if err != nil || event == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s decode: %+v, %v", observation.Role, event, err)
		}
		want := map[string]any{"nftId": "1", "oldStrategy": observation.Old, "newStrategy": observation.New}
		if event.EventName != "FeeStrategyChanged" || event.Sig != "FeeStrategyChanged(uint256,uint8,uint8)" || !reflect.DeepEqual(event.Args, want) || event.BlockNumber != log.BlockNumber || event.LogIndex != log.Index || event.TxHash != strings.ToLower(log.TxHash.Hex()) {
			t.Fatalf("%s decoded interface: %+v, want %+v", observation.Role, event, want)
		}
		for replay := 0; replay < 2; replay++ {
			webhook, err := processor.processEvent(ctx, event, 1700000000, nil)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s handler rejected real log: %v", observation.Role, err)
			}
			if webhook == nil || webhook.EventName != event.EventName || !reflect.DeepEqual(webhook.Args, want) {
				t.Fatalf("%s webhook lost canonical arguments: %+v", observation.Role, webhook)
			}
		}
		id := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", event.TxHash, event.LogIndex)
		var nft, block, timestamp int64
		var old, next, index int32
		var tx string
		err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT nft_id,old_strategy,new_strategy,block_number,block_timestamp,tx_hash,log_index FROM indexer.fee_strategy_changes WHERE id=$1`, id).Scan(&nft, &old, &next, &block, &timestamp, &tx, &index)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if nft != 1 || old != int32(observation.Old) || next != int32(observation.New) || block != int64(log.BlockNumber) || timestamp != 1700000000 || tx != event.TxHash || index != int32(log.Index) {
			t.Fatalf("%s persisted wrong row: %d %d %d %d %d %s %d", observation.Role, nft, old, next, block, timestamp, tx, index)
		}
		malformed := log
		malformed.Topics = log.Topics[:1]
		if decoded, err := decoder.Decode(malformed); err == nil || decoded != nil {
			t.Fatal("missing indexed NFT accepted")
		}
		malformed = log
		malformed.Data = log.Data[:len(log.Data)-1]
		if decoded, err := decoder.Decode(malformed); err == nil || decoded != nil {
			t.Fatal("truncated strategy accepted")
		}
	}
	var count int
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM indexer.fee_strategy_changes`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if count != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("replay persisted %d rows, want 3", count)
	}
	if decoded, err := decoder.Decode(types.Log{Topics: []common.Hash{common.HexToHash("0xdeadbeef")}}); err != nil || decoded != nil {
		t.Fatal("unknown topic accepted")
	}
}
